title: Making Good a Returned Payment — Installment Payment Plans Desk Reference
content:
**Subject.** Under the **Installment Payment Plans**, when a payment returned on a plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term has not been made good and the named insured makes it good, the representative takes the makeup payment by a one-time card or bank payment the named insured authorizes. The makeup is recorded against the invoice the returned payment had paid and references the returned payment. It is applied as the plan's payment application sets, so it settles the returned installment and the fees standing against it first, and what it carries ahead is held as a credit for the installments not yet invoiced.

**Returned payments the makeup schedule covers.** The schedule covers a payment returned on a plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term that backs at most one certificate, a payment whose installment invoice, if it had paid one, has no other payment posted against it, and whose plan's next installment invoice, if already issued, has at most one payment posted against it. A payment recorded against an invoice counts as another payment unless it is the returned payment itself or a makeup referencing it. For any other returned payment no makeup is figured (the figure is 0.00), and it is made good as every other one-time payment is, for the amount the customer states, and applied as every other payment on its plan is: on a Monthly EFT or Monthly Card Autopay plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term to past-due invoices oldest first (fees before premium), then to unpaid late and NSF fees, then to the current invoice, whatever it leaves being held on the plan as a credit that its draft notices carry as their credit schedule sets, and on any other plan in the plan's payment application order.

**Already made good.** A returned payment against which a payment referencing it already stands has been made good, and no makeup is figured for it (0.00).

**Authorization.** For a returned-payment makeup, the named insured authorizes the payment personally by running it with the representative, choosing the payment method and confirming the amount the representative states.

## The payment function: `authorize_makeup_payment_1af63ac0`

**Capability.** Through `authorize_makeup_payment_1af63ac0` the named insured personally authorizes a one-time payment, taken today by a representative over the phone, that makes good a payment the bank returned on an installment payment plan. On success a payment for the authorized amount is posted to the plan today through the representative phone channel, linked to the invoice the returned payment had paid and referencing the returned payment it makes good; the plan's account balance falls by the amount; and a payment confirmation number is issued to the customer.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool: the representative unlocks `authorize_makeup_payment_1af63ac0` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `billing_plan_id` | The reference number of the installment payment plan that receives the payment, read from the plan record returned by the plan lookup. |
| `related_invoice_id` | The reference number of the installment invoice the returned payment had paid, read from the plan's invoice and ledger lookups. |
| `related_payment_txn_id` | The reference number of the original payment the bank returned, which this payment makes good, read from the plan ledger lookup. |
| `payment_method` | How the customer pays, exactly one of: `debit_card` — the customer pays with a debit card they hold and state; `credit_card` — the customer pays with a credit card they hold and state; `bank_ach` — the customer pays from a checking or savings account they hold, by routing and account number; `personal_check` — a paper check the customer has mailed or handed in, never one taken over the phone; `money_order` — a money order the customer has mailed or handed in, never one taken over the phone; `cashiers_check` — a cashier's check the customer has mailed or handed in, never one taken over the phone; `cash` — cash handed in at an agent office, never one taken over the phone. |
| `amount` | The amount the customer authorizes, in USD with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent. |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the payment confirmation number (PMT- followed by ten digits), the payment reference number, the amount (USD, two decimals), the method, the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the plan's account balance after the payment (USD, two decimals). The confirmation number indicates the payment was accepted and posted.
